items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: Jack Lane and Johnny Lawler used to tell me about playing.

ctx.x: I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. I'm tired. I like that funny. I can't do it. I got stranded in Hammond and I got turned upside down. You know how you get in a place and you can't get any sleep and everything? Yeah. You've had that happen to you when you're on the road. Oh yeah. You can't think straight. Alright. Did you ever see any funerals playing with a brass band and all that?

I've seen them years ago. I never played much. You know. When I lived down the quarter there you'd see them every once in a while. You'd see them all over. Jack Lane and Johnny Lawler used to tell me about playing.
Yeah. You know you must have known Johnny Lawler when you were a little boy because he was a footer.
